capabilities: browse downloaded Midjourney images in a gallery view
read full prompts from PNG metadata with filename parsing as fallback
search prompts, parameters, filenames, job IDs and usernames
view images in a lightbox with copy and insert actions
embed grid, masonry, strip, slideshow or random galleries in notes
disambiguation: Does not connect to Midjourney or generate images; it only reads image files you have already downloaded.
extras: Unofficial plugin, not affiliated with or endorsed by Midjourney, Inc.; asks for donations via buy-me-a-coffee; extra documentation and a one-click install button live on an external website.
problem: Midjourney truncates image filenames at about 100 characters, so browsing downloaded images in Obsidian loses the long prompts stored in the files.

relations.evidence: Browse a folder of downloaded Midjourney images inside Obsidian

summary: Gallery viewer for downloaded Midjourney images that reads full prompts from PNG metadata, with search, a lightbox, and embeddable galleries.
